baseline_models.focus_anchor: The given book, what was sent down, rejoicing, parties, denial, and the partitive object.
baseline_models.mechanism: Giving and descent place one assembled book before plural recipients; joy marks recognition while factional denial partitions its reception at a part. The social split lies in uptake, not in the source's wholeness.

activation_trace.role: Giving and bringing something to another makes the book a received trust rather than a self-produced possession.
Joining one thing to another supplies the book's integrated-whole function in the mechanism.
Expansive delight marks one mode of receptive recognition.
Caused descent and delivery make revelation an arrival from beyond the recipients.
A group consolidated around one view supplies the social machinery of selective resistance.
Nonrecognition and denial name the rejecting operation performed by a party.
Dividing a thing into a part scopes the rejection without making the delivered source intrinsically fragmentary.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely reports that two populations have different opinions about a revelation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages one integrated delivery whose reception splits socially: recognition opens into joy, while factional identity permits denial to cut at a part.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive command to worship, refusal of association, call toward Him, and return toward Him.
baseline_models.mechanism: Commanded submission, refusal of shared ownership, directed calling, and directed return form one vector. The closing clauses are not a list of beliefs but a movement whose sole authority, addressee, and endpoint coincide.

activation_trace.role: Binding request and obligation make worship a received commission rather than self-appointed authority.
Obedience with submission supplies the enacted posture of the vector.
The sole object of devotion fixes the vector's center.
Shared ownership and participation define precisely what the exclusive vector refuses.
Calling and inclining by speech give the vector its present outward action.
Return to a place and gathering point gives the vector its terminal direction.

changed_reading.before: The second half is a compact doctrinal declaration followed by prayer and an afterlife destination.
changed_reading.after: It is a directional commission: submit to one authority, admit no co-owner, call toward the same center now, and travel toward that same center as return.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The giving of the book, its descent, and the denial of a part.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two distant giving branches picture a managed watercourse and a flood arriving from elsewhere; descent adds vertical arrival, while the assembled book supplies what the flow carries. Before context, this is only a latent spatial model of revelation entering a receiving terrain where uptake can be partitioned.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse and the routing of its flow turn giving into a channelled arrival image.
A flood arriving from another land adds the surprising image of benefit crossing from a struck source to an unstruck receiver.
Downward movement and settling supply the flow's vertical entry into a receiving place.
Joined components keep the flowing delivery anchored to an integrated book.
Partitive division leaves open differential uptake within the receiving terrain.

changed_reading.before: The book is a static object handed to its recipients.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus already permits a routed-arrival picture: an integrated disclosure descends and enters a receiving terrain whose response can divide.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent plots receive one water yet yield differently. This activates the focus as a reception ecology: one descent can produce joy in some book-recipients and partial denial in parties without making the source internally contradictory.

activation_trace.role: An allotted share of irrigation and its channel make uptake depend on distribution through receivers.
Literal water supplies the common medium from which differentiated effects arise.
Numerical oneness marks the irrigation source as one rather than merely similar.
Graded excellence supplies the unequal yield produced from the common input.
Part-to-part comparison prefigures the focus's partitive grammar while assigning difference to outcomes.
Delivered descent anchors the irrigation analogy back in the focus.
The denied part is reread within a whole whose reception, rather than source, differentiates.

structural_cues: 13:4 places one irrigation source before a repeated part-to-part contrast; 13:36 places one descent before rejoicing and partial denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent plots, one water, unequal produce, and repeated partitive grammar; I map water to descent and plots to recipient formations. A live alternative is that 13:4 remains only a creation sign and does not classify scriptural response.

changed_reading.before: Different reactions imply that the descended material itself presents different or incompatible portions.
changed_reading.after: One source can remain one while recipient terrains yield unlike responses; joy and partial denial expose differentiated uptake of the same descent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The true call is set against hands extended toward water that never reaches the mouth. This revises calling as directed relation and response, not an attempt to seize or manipulate a resource; the focus's paired return then completes that orientation.

activation_trace.role: Calling and inclining by speech organize both the true address and its failed substitutes.
Extending the hand supplies the attempt to obtain by reach.
The outstretched palm of a petitioner makes bodily grasping the failed countermodel to true invocation.
Literal water supplies the desired object that remains outside the grasper's control.
Reaching a destination marks the result that the extended hands cannot cause.
The focus's call becomes the rightly directed counterpart to failed grasping.
Return to the gathering point extends directed address into directed destiny.

structural_cues: 13:14 repeats calling around an extended-hand comparison and failed reaching; 13:36 repeats the same destination before both call and return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies true calling, futile bodily reach, water, and failed arrival; I infer that proper invocation is responsive orientation rather than possession. Alternatively, the water image may only expose false invocation without defining the focus's call.

changed_reading.before: Calling to Him means only praying to Him or verbally inviting others.
changed_reading.after: Calling is a nonpossessive orientation toward the only true respondent; it cannot be replaced by grasping at an apparently available power.

context_deltas.mechanism: A single descent becomes streams according to channel capacity, carries floating foam, and leaves what benefits. It fully activates the focus's latent watercourse and incoming-flood branches: the book enters differently capacitated formations, and selective denial can be pictured as surface disturbance rather than a defect in the descending source.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and delivery provide the common incoming source.
Flowing floodwater turns descent into movement through receiving channels.
A measure that brings each thing to its limit assigns differing capacity to the channels.
Floating foam supplies a visible but nonenduring surface response.
Benefit opposed to harm identifies the durable function of what remains.
Stable remaining after waiting distinguishes durable uptake from passing foam.
The focus inventory's routed watercourse now supplies the book's path into receivers.
The focus inventory's externally arriving flood becomes an activated image of transmitted revelation.
Partitive denial is anchored as one possible selective response within the receiving formation.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats descent and then unfolds a water mechanism already latent in two focus branches of giving.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, capacity-shaped channels, foam, benefit, and remaining; I map the book to the incoming flow, recipient formations to channels, and denial to a possible surface rejection. The live alternative is that the mechanism distinguishes truth from falsehood without mapping particular communities onto valleys or foam.

changed_reading.before: Giving the book transfers a fixed informational object, and denial is simply a contrary proposition.
changed_reading.after: The delivery behaves like an incoming flow: capacity shapes uptake, transient surface reactions can swell, and durable benefit may remain beneath the visible dispute.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired sequences of fulfilling, not unbinding, and connecting versus unbinding and cutting turn partial denial into a relational operation. Because the focus book is assembled by joining, rejection of a part can be read as cutting a connected whole and the covenantal community organized around it.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the positive whole-preserving action.
Unbinding what was made firm supplies the inverse operation.
A confirmed covenant supplies the bonded structure that can be preserved or broken.
Uninterrupted sequence of part after part supplies the connected-whole image.
Severing connection supplies the destructive counterpart to joining.
Joining components makes the focus book a structure whose integrity matters.
The denied part locates where the cut is attempted within that structure.

structural_cues: 13:20-21 and 13:25 form positive and inverted sequences: preserve and connect versus unbind and cut.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a deliberate connect-or-cut reversal; I infer that the assembled book participates in this integrity logic. Alternatively, the sequence may concern covenant and social bonds without specifying how denial of revelation operates.

changed_reading.before: Denying a part is an isolated disagreement about one detachable claim.
changed_reading.after: Partial denial can function as a cut through an integrated and bonded whole, altering relations among text, covenant, and community.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same joy root attaches once to the descended book and once to the near life reduced to temporary enjoyment. Joy is therefore not self-authenticating; its object and direction determine whether expansion becomes receptive delight or boastful enclosure.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary delight supplies the affect shared with the focus before its object differentiates it.
Boastful excessive joy supplies the latent danger of affect closing around its immediate object.
The lower or nearer world locates the rival object within proximity rather than final return.
Enjoyable temporary benefit supplies the limited horizon of the contrasted joy.
The focus directs expansive delight toward what descended rather than what is merely near.
The written book fixes the object that gives the focus joy its receptive value.

structural_cues: The same affective root recurs ten verses apart, but the focus attaches it to descent while 13:26 attaches it to the near life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and sharply different objects; I infer an affective redirection from temporary proximity to received disclosure. The alternative is that each occurrence is locally independent and no evaluative contrast is intended.

changed_reading.before: Rejoicing by itself proves that the recipients are rightly aligned.
changed_reading.after: Joy becomes diagnostic only through its attachment: the focus depicts affect opened by received disclosure, while nearby context warns how the same expansion can close around the merely near.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning toward Him, hearts settling in remembrance, a good return, and repeated destination syntax activate return as both present recurrence and final endpoint. The focus's call and return become a feedback motion: address, reorientation, settling, and eventual gathering.

activation_trace.role: Habitual return and recurrence supply the present-tense turning that precedes final return.
Repeated return to a place or direction preserves the split root's second recurrent-motion image.
Settling and tranquility supply the inner state produced by recurrent orientation.
The heart supplies the site in which return becomes present stabilization.
Return to a destination extends the recurrent motion into a good endpoint.
Directed calling supplies the repeated outward act that initiates reorientation.
The focus's gathering-point return names both the governing direction and terminal arrival.

structural_cues: Destination wording recurs with turning in 13:27, trust and return in 13:30, and paired call and return in 13:36.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent turning, heart-settling, good return, and repeated destination syntax; I connect them as one recursive trajectory. Alternatively, they may remain adjacent devotional states without a single feedback mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Return in the focus names only a remote postmortem destination.
changed_reading.after: Return is already practiced as repeated reorientation and settling; final gathering is the completion of a motion active in the call itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: All affair belongs to God, guidance remains His, signs require permission, and delivery is separated from account. The focus command is therefore a bounded commission to worship and call, not authority to compel reception; refusing partnership also means refusing to claim divine causal control.

activation_trace.role: The whole affair and case centralize governing agency outside the messenger.
Gentle direction to the path identifies guidance as an agency distinct from mere proclamation.
Permission to act limits sign-production and marks delegated scope.
Delivering a message defines the speaker's assigned outward task.
Counting and account reserve evaluation beyond the act of delivery.
The received command anchors the speaker as commissioned rather than sovereign.
Calling supplies the bounded communicative action actually claimed.
Refusal of shared participation blocks any claim to co-own the result.

structural_cues: The focus's restrictive command formula is echoed by 13:40's restrictive assignment of delivery, while 13:31 and 13:38 reserve affair and permission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies agency limits, permission, delivery, and account; I infer that these delimit the focus command and call. A live alternative is that the focus restriction concerns only worship's content, not the messenger's causal role.

changed_reading.before: The speaker announces monotheism with an open-ended mandate to secure assent.
changed_reading.after: The speaker claims a sharply bounded role: obey, worship, and call, while neither coercing uptake nor sharing ownership of guidance, signs, or account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A book can mark a fixed term, while erasure, establishment, and a source-book introduce levels of inscription under one authority. This expands the focus book beyond a static codex into written disclosure, binding decree, and an ordered register without forcing those uses to be one referent.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription as decree or measure makes book govern a fixed term.
Removal of an effect supplies controlled alteration within the inscription field.
Durable establishment supplies the counter-operation to erasure.
An origin, collector, and reference point supplies hierarchy among book-levels.
The written object anchors the source-reference as inscription rather than an abstract theme.
The received written book remains the focus-level disclosure encountered by communities.
Binding judgment keeps the received book connected to authoritative decree.

structural_cues: Book language moves from a term-specific record in 13:38 to erasure, establishment, and a source-book in 13:39 after the focus's received book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several inscription functions and a source relation; I infer a layered book field that thickens the focus term. The live alternative is that received scripture, term-record, and source-book are separate referents linked only by lexical reuse.

changed_reading.before: The focus book is only a static physical text that recipients either like or dispute.
changed_reading.after: The focus participates in a layered inscription field: readable disclosure and binding determination stand under a source authority that can establish ordered records.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sufficiency, informed witness, and knowledge of the book convert reception from private approval into public attestation. Those given the book may therefore function not merely as a pleased audience but as an epistemic counterweight to factional denial.

activation_trace.role: Standing for an affair until sufficiency is achieved gives the witness evidentiary adequacy.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the public evidentiary act.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the witness's epistemic basis.
The written book fixes what the witness knows rather than leaving testimony generic.
Receiving the book supplies the prior relation from which informed witness can emerge.
Receptive delight becomes the affective face of recognition that may mature into testimony.
Factional consolidation supplies the contested social field in which witness matters.

structural_cues: The surah closes with book-knowledge positioned between denial of messengership and sufficing witness, retroactively giving the focus recipients a possible public role.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a book-knowing witness after the focus; I infer a possible overlap in function with those given the book. The alternative is that the closing witness is a distinct individual or class, so identity should remain unresolved.

changed_reading.before: The book-recipients' joy is private agreement that has no further function.
changed_reading.after: Their reception can be read as potential public attestation: knowledgeable recognition stands within a contested field against factional denial.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The burdening-with-debt branch is surprising because the surface verb denotes joy, but it remains anchored to that exact focus root and converges with giving, binding book, and command. Carry it only as a secondary counterpressure: joy may coexist with entrusted weight, not secretly mean sadness or debt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The recipients are given a binding book and rejoice before the speaker names a command.

activation_trace.role: Burdening with debt or deposits adds entrusted weight beneath the overt affect of joy.
Giving places the weight in the recipients' custody rather than making it self-chosen.
Binding judgment turns the received book into obligation as well as written gift.
Obligatory command shows how received disclosure can demand enactment.

changed_reading.before: Rejoicing depicts uncomplicated pleasure at receiving information.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the delight also bears the pressure of custody: what gladdens the recipient is a binding trust that must be carried.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The forceful-push image comes from the non-dominant mapped root and is therefore branch-distant; it remains anchored to the focus call and coheres with refusal of association and the trap branch. Render it only as kinetic imagery for urgent dislodging, never as a replacement definition of calling or a warrant for human coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Calling toward Him is immediately framed by refusal of association and return to Him.

activation_trace.role: A severe push supplies the exploratory kinetic force of dislodging attachment from rival directions.
A hunter's snare pictures shared allegiance as an entanglement from which the call dislodges.
Return to the gathering point gives the dislodged movement a positive destination.

changed_reading.before: The call is only calm verbal address.
changed_reading.after: As contained kinetic imagery, the call can also unsettle and push free from entangling co-allegiances so that return regains one direction.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Mapping territorial edge-loss onto interpretation is cross-domain and not asserted by the packet, but it remains anchored to the focus's partitive denial and to later diminution from edges under judgment. Use it only as an erosion analogy: rejecting a part may alter the boundary of the whole, not as a claim that 13:41 directly interprets 13:36.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A party denies a part of an integrated book.

activation_trace.role: Partitioning supplies the point at which denial removes something from a whole.
Loss of some of a thing supplies gradual diminution rather than one total rupture.
The edge and endpoint locate diminution at a boundary that defines the whole.
Judgment supplies the authoritative frame against which boundary erosion is measured.

changed_reading.before: Denying a part leaves the rest of the book and the denier's relation to it unchanged.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, partial denial behaves like erosion from an edge: a local subtraction can redraw the practical boundary of the whole.

strongest_changes: One descent can remain whole while differently formed recipients yield joy or partial denial.
The focus's watercourse and incoming-flood branches become a capacity-and-residue mechanism in 13:17.
Calling is directed, nonpossessive relation, and return is a recurrent present motion as well as an endpoint.
Partial denial can operate as cutting a joined covenantal whole rather than disputing a detachable sentence.
The speaker's exclusive command is a bounded noncoercive commission, not shared control over guidance or account.
summary.what_was_special: The focus inventory itself planted watercourse, foreign-flood, debt, forceful-push, snare, and repeated-motion images. Ordered context activated several while leaving integrated delivery, affective contrast, recurrent return, layered inscription, and public witness as coexisting readings rather than one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The water, plot, valley, and foam correspondences are reader-supplied analogies; the packet does not explicitly identify communities with channels or denial with foam.
The relation among received scripture, term-record, and source-book may be lexical resonance rather than referential identity.
The identity or overlap of the focus book-recipients and the closing book-knowing witness remains unresolved.
The entrusted-weight and forceful-disentangling outliers depend on branch-distant images and require explicit qualification.
